1.mascotDialogue: One edge, beta, but TWO entries in the adjacency matrix! Forget the second one, and — arre — you've quietly built half a directed graph by accident.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 2 and line 3 are not optional extras of each other, beta — they are the SAME conceptual edge, and they must be added together, as one single atomic pair, every single time.

3.mascotDialogue: No arrowheads this time, beta — just a plain line, because the connection is inherently mutual. Both sides agree, like a proper handshake.

4.mascotDialogue: The visual is showing a single arrowhead where an undirected graph should never, ever have one — that mismatch IS the bug, beta, made impossible to miss.
